title: Castile under Philip II: fiscal accounts by period, 1566-1596, and debt sustainability (Drelichman & Voth 2010, Tables 2 and 3)
source: M. Drelichman and H.-J. Voth, 'The Sustainable Debts of Philip II: A Reconstruction of Castile's Fiscal Position, 1566-1596', Journal of Economic History 70(4) (2010); unabridged version, Table 2 (PDF p. 15) and Table 3 (PDF p. 19)
series: Table 2 'Fiscal Accounts, 1566-96 (period averages)': Panel A (nominal, million of ducats) and Panel C (% of revenue); Table 3 'Sustainability calculations - baseline results': g (growth rate of revenue, %), r (interest rate, %), PS* (primary surplus required to stabilize the debt/revenue ratio), PS (actual primary surplus relative to revenue), D* (debt/revenue ratio that can be sustained given actual primary surpluses), D (actual debt/revenue). Columns: table, period, item, value, unit
license: Authors' unabridged working version, freely available on the first author's page; two small tables transcribed for teaching and comment, with attribution.
notes: Transcribed from the PDF's text layer (pdftotext -layout; PDF SHA-256 b9f227a64f7c6cdcb234f0a36c770db222143ee2a3118ceae8ab06a3105a84da).
